files.content:
# Examples/Set a status dialog

An inline form section with status-friendly suggestions and renamed categories.

Install the v5 emoji-picker-react candidate, import app.css and picker.css, then render <Shell className="status-picker" />. For CSS Modules, import picker.module.css and pass styles.picker as className. The component includes its app context; adapt its insertion callback to your product.
